description: Returns local-model inference metrics — call count, local vs cloud split, token totals, per-model breakdown, and average latency. period: 'session' (default) reports this MCP process's prism_infer delegation only. period: 'all' imports the Synalux VS Code panel spool and reports persisted MCP + panel usage across restarts, including the panel local-serve rate. This does not include the host model's (Claude's) own token spend (use /cost for that).

period.description: Metrics window: 'session' (this MCP process) or 'all' (durable MCP + VS Code panel ledger).

name: inference_metrics
